ImageDescription.value: Tschierva Glacier (Romansh: Vadret da Tschierva) as seen from Piz Corvatsch station. The high peak dominating the center left of the image is Piz Bernina decorated with the Biancograt a distinct ice ridge. Piz Bernina is the only mountain exceeding 4000m in Engadin. The peak on the right is Piz Roseg. The Tschierva hut is visible above the left glacier moraine. The image is stitched from more than 20 individual images taken with a Canon Powershot G3.
